notes.title: Major Patch 4
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Warriors[/b]
We are hyped to push our fourth Major Patch! As always we appreciate your patience, and we'll continue to post announcements on our future plans in [b][url=https://discord.gg/BqZPffsfwE]our Discord[/url][/b].

[previewyoutube=AxIS9AguW9s;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Early Access 0.5.0[/b]

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]First pass of Unit SFX for basic attacks and (non-Warrior) explosions
[*]Reworked Achievements to Quests and Early Progression (removed existing T3/T4 units unlocks until new Quests are completed)
[*]Reworked Talents and reset all Talent Points
[*]First pass of Lifetime Stats
[*]New look for all Dragons
[*]Added tracking fastest Clear Time for all +5 Maps
[*]Changed Map 3 to Map 6 and pushed former Maps 4-6 down to 3-5
[*]Added a Map loading system to reduce game size on disk
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Enemy Vassal showing green HP bar 
[*]Fixed Elf Warrior DOT doing too much damage
[*]Fixed Elf Warrior duration lasting too long
[*]Fixed some Warriors not tracking kills in specific situations
[*]Still testing bandaid fixes for Orc Warrior as we setup to rework in 0.6.0, sorry!
[*]Fixed Enraged Lizard Wizard dying after attacking once
[*]Fixed Reroll button showing on the first Artifact Selection
[/list]
[b]Map Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the Enemy Castle to stop regenning HP if any of the T3 Towers are down (previously required all T3 Towers down)
[*]Minor adjustment to Player and Enemy spawn positions
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]General QOL to most places
[*]New End Round screen
[*]Added pressing the Escape key on Main Menu to close menus or open the Options
[*]Changed some UI sounds and added them to a few missing places
[/list]

You can always find the patch notes and other announcements in [b][url=https://discord.gg/BqZPffsfwE]our Discord[/url][/b]

Thanks!
Kall and darbs

notes.title: Major Patch 3 Update
notes.notes:
Hello Warriors,

As we are approaching the release of patch 0.4 we wanted to update you guys on what features and changes to expect in this patch. We are still about 2 weeks away from the patch dropping but you will be playing the patch this month! There are a few key things we wanted to go over with this patch as there are quite a few big changes to the game.

First things first, [b]WE WILL BE WIPING SAVED DATA WITH THIS PATCH[/b]. We do not do this lightly and were trying to avoid this but we think its best for a lot of reasons. The early game is getting a massive overhaul on how you unlock units, warriors, and things like towers. Instead of unlocking units or warriors with gold they are now unlocked via achievements. In our previous versions it would take 10+ hours of gameplay to fully unlock all the units. This process has been streamlined down to a few hours max now. When you clear the 6 maps on their base difficulty you will have unlocked the full unit roster now. These system rewrites have made it very difficult for some save files to transition to the new patch without lots of bugs and errors.

The second reason for the wipe is the new talent system. The Talent system has been set up in a way that when you clear a map for the first time you get +1 talent point. With how we set up this system it was also interacting poorly with our old saves. Players who had cleared most of the maps or partial clears were going to be forced to go back and individually clear maps they already cleared to reclaim those talent points. As with the above system changes this was also leading to frustrating gameplay experiences with the new patch.

Addressing all the problems with save data and the current patch would have caused far too many delays. Add on the fact that we really want you guys to test out the new early game systems, a wipe seems like the best option for us. We aren't happy about this and will be doing everything we can to avoid save wipes in the future. The new early game is way smoother to get through now though, and we hope you won't find it as tedious as your first play through.

With that out of the way here is what to expect from this patch!

Talents - Clear a map for the first time and get +1 talent point with currently 36 talent points total in the game. These talents can be placed into Offensive, Defensive, or Utility trees. You are able to reset your talents at any time to try out multiple builds and styles. As we add more maps and difficulty levels the total amount of talent points in the game will increase over time.

Early Game Overhaul - Unlocking Units is now done by clearing maps. You will unlock the first half of a faction by surviving 10 minutes on a map and the second half of the faction by clearing the map. By the time you have cleared all 6 base maps you will have access to the full 50 unit roster and a handful of warriors. Once map 6 has been cleared you will gain access to Artifacts and Difficulty scaling.

Artifact rework - Artifacts have gotten major changes in this patch. We have fully removed the generic artifacts that buff all units by a percentage. We have added faction based artifacts and warrior artifacts that drastically change how the warrior ability works. We have also reworked both the dwarf and elf warrior abilities so make sure the check them out!

Patch will also feature a change to map sizes, +5 difficulty maps, and some unit balance changes.

We greatly appreciate all the support you guys have given us over the last several months. The game has seriously changed quite a bit since launch and its because of your feedback. Please continue giving us your feedback, bug reports, and support because it's fueling us hard! Drop a steam review if you haven't as its the best way to support us currently! We will have the exact date for the release of this patch soon but expect it before the end of the month for sure!

notes.title: Major Patch 2
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Warriors[/b]
Sorry it's a few days late, but we're glad to push our second Major Patch! Thanks for your patience, and we'll continue to post any future delays in [b][url=https://discord.gg/BqZPffsfwE]our Discord[/url][/b].

[b]Important: we will be wiping all progress Major Patch 3 or Major Patch 4[/b]

[u]Patch Overview[/u] [previewyoutube=Ab1lElx_cYw;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
This patch adds new content while building on Map Difficulty changes from the last Minor Patch, and it also features a rework of the progression system.
[list]
[*] New Warrior: Summoner
[*] Reworked Difficulty Scaling Maps
[*] Added +4 maps
[*] Reworked Unit Unlocking System
[*] Many Balance Change and More!
[/list]
You can find the detailed patch notes in [b][url=https://discord.gg/BqZPffsfwE]our Discord[/url][/b]

Thanks!
Kall and darbs

notes.title: Major Patch 1
notes.notes:
Hey Warriors! 

We would like to start our first Major Patch notes by saying thank you to everyone! All of your screenshots, bug reports, balance feedback, and general discussion both on the Steam Forums and in our Discord means a lot to both of us. Another big thank you to the content creators we've seen put out Castle Warriors videos and streams! 

This first Major Patch is our tightest window with only around two weeks of development time, but every following Major Patch has a full month scheduled. We're looking forward to the next few months of Early Access and hope to hear more from you all!

[h3][b]Major 0.2.0[/b][/h3]
[i]this version number should show in the bottom left of your Main Menu[/i]

[b]Break Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]More small lag fixes as we rewrite some of our existing systems for the big lag fix
[*]Pretty sure we fixed all of the Orc Warrior bugs, but please let us know if you see one
[*]Fixed some Enemy units not taking damage from Damage over Time Abilities
[/list]
[b]Player Unit Changes[/b]
[list]
[u]All[/u]
[*]Added, updated, or fixed various Ability animations

[u]Elf[/u]
[*]Added Phoenix+ ability to Phoenix with reduced Ability Damage
[/list]
[b]Map Changes[/b]
[list]
[u]Map 3[/u]
[*]Reworked Map 3 +0 to be in line with other +0 maps

[u]Difficulty Scaled[/u]
[*]Reworked +1, +2, and +3 maps to be more difficult
[*]Enemy units will upgrade to a more powerful version after 4 minutes of spawning

[u]Bonus Map[/u]
[*]Added experimental Bonus Map that unlocks after purchasing all 50 units + 5 Faction Warriors
[*]The Artifact system has arrived to the Bonus Map, let us know what you think!
[/list]
[b]Warrior Changes[/b]
[list]
[u]Elf[/u]
[*]Buffed Warrior Ability size

[u]Neutral[/u]
[*]Added two Warriors that automatically unlock after beating Map 6
[/list]
[b]Upgrade Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the Gold costs for Reroll 1-3
[*]Adjusted when Reroll 2 and Tower 2 unlock
[/list]
[b]UI Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Warrior information to Tavern
[*]Expanded the Options menu
[*]Fixed Volume Sliders not visually updating to saved settings on load
[*]Added SFX when changing volume sliders
[*]Fixed close button on ingame pause screen
[*]Fixed Warrior Ability cooldown indicator showing over the scaling text
[*]Added tooltip to the bottom right of the Card selection screen
[*]Added two diagrams to the Main Menu Help screen
[*]A lot of small tweaks that no one will notice
[/list]
[i][b]Planned for 0.2.1 or 0.2.2[/b][/i]
[i]-Restart Save
-Artifacts GUI [/i]


You can always find the patch notes earlier [url=https://discord.gg/BqZPffsfwE]in our Discord[/url]
